intro.heading: One place, whichever path you're on
intro.body: A fertility journey doesn't move in a straight line, and it doesn't move the same way for everyone. IUI and IVF ask different things of you than donor or surrogacy paths do, and none of them ask what a generic tracker assumes. This adapts to the path you're actually on — and lets you change it, because paths change.

features.title: Adapts to your path

privacy.heading: Private by design, not by promise
privacy.body: This is a single file that opens in any browser and works entirely offline. No account. No cloud. No subscription. Nothing you type is ever sent anywhere. It never asks for an insurance ID number, a medical record number, or a password — only what you choose to write down, and only you decide what that is.

cards.title: Zero network requests
cards.body: The app is a single file that runs entirely in your browser, on your device. It makes no connections and loads nothing from the internet. You can run it with Wi-Fi off.

cards.title: Never a password
cards.body: By design, it never asks for or stores passwords or PINs. It records that accounts exist and where your written instructions live — the map, never the keys.

cards.title: Yours forever
cards.body: One-time purchase. The file is yours, works offline for life, and will still open years from now, exactly as it does today.
